title: Purview Scan Failures
dataSources: Catalog audit events (`collibra:audit`, `atlan:audit`, `datahub:audit`), OpenLineage run events (`openlineage:event`), Unity Catalog audit logs, Purview scan/classification results, stewardship and access-policy change events.
app: Collibra / Alation / Atlan / DataHub / Microsoft Purview / Databricks Unity Catalog audit logs and REST APIs via HEC scripted inputs; OpenLineage/Marquez events via HEC.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=purview:scan
| stats count as scans, sum(eval(status="Failed")) as failures by data_source, scan_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Tracks Microsoft Purview scan runs and flags failed scans, which leave the catalog and classifications stale for the affected sources.
value: A failed Purview scan means the catalog no longer reflects reality for that source; catching failures keeps governance metadata trustworthy.
implementation: Ingest Purview scan events; schedule daily; alert on failures for key sources.
visualization: Table of failing scans, timechart of scan failures.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the jobs that keep your data catalogue up to date and flag when one fails, so the catalogue stays accurate.
